source.dictionaryEditor.rubyTagInstructions: Use ruby tags for phonetic annotations
source.dictionaryEditor.rubyTagsStep1: 1. Select text in the pronunciation field (top), then select the corresponding text in the phrase field (bottom)
source.dictionaryEditor.rubyTagsStep2: 2. The selected portions will be paired and moved to the ruby tag preview
source.dictionaryEditor.rubyTagsStep3: 3. Continue selecting pairs until both fields are empty
source.dictionaryEditor.rubyTagsStep4: 4. Click Save to apply the ruby tags

source.recordingStudioEnhanced.tips: Tips: Use filters to clean up background noise and enhance speech. Click on a track to select it for recording. Generated audio will be appended to the selected track. Drag to select portions of audio and use the cut button to remove them.
